g.text: - CustomerId is a unique identifier for a customer.
- Must be a string representing the customer ID.
- ProductId is a unique identifier for a product.
- Must be a string representing the product ID.
- Product is the common identity and lifecycle
- Every Product must be a SellableProduct,
- The generalization is complete and overlapping.
- All Product subtypes share the same ProductId.
- Stock control is independent of product type.
- A Product may contain zero or more
- A Product with no composition items is
- Each Product directly owns zero or more composition items.
- Each item references exactly one child Product and records
- Every referenced child Product must be classified as SellableProduct, PizzaComponent, or both.
- If a child Product is used multiple times by the same parent,
represent it once and combine its quantity.
- Nested Products are expanded recursively when deriving
ingredient requirements, allergens, availability and price.
- A component is a PizzaComponent subclass of Product and
A PredefinedPizza is always sellable and uses the Product
composition inherited from Product as its default recipe.
It has no separate identifier or second composition list.
The catalogue containing predefined pizzas is public and
Availability is evaluated per size. A size or required
size-specific configuration that is inactive or missing makes
the pizza unavailable for that size. If no valid sizes remain,
the pizza is unavailable overall. Reactivation requires
validation against current composition rules, active products
and at least one valid size.
- CategoryId is a unique identifier for a product category.
- Must be a string representing the category ID.
- AllergenId is a unique identifier for an allergen.
- Must be an integer between 1 and 14 (inclusive),
corresponding to the official EU Regulation No. 1169/2011.
- ComponentTypeId is a unique identifier for a pizza component type.
- Must be a string representing the component type ID.
- A Product used in a pizza composition has a size-specific configuration. The configuration defines both price and consumed stock units per size.
- A Product + Pizza Size pair identifies at most one configuration.
- Stock consumption is derived from the recursively expanded composition and configured quantities.
- StockId is a unique identifier for a stock item.
- Must be a string representing the stock ID.
in which stock control is enabled for a Product.
- availableUnits is a non-negative integer; an
adjustment that would make it negative is rejected.
- A zero quantity makes the Product out of stock, but
does not deactivate it or remove stock control.
movement-by-movement history is not required here.
